title: Request
description: The only frame a client sends.

idempotencyKey.description:
1 to 128 bytes of printable ASCII without spaces. Spec 0007 decides
what it means.

requestId.description:
1 to 64 bytes of `[A-Za-z0-9._:-]`, chosen by the client and unique
on the connection while the request runs. `stackly-ipc` uses a
lowercase UUID v7.

expectedRevision.description:
The revision the person saw when they confirmed; required, so an
abandon only applies to the state they looked at.

ApplyConfigParams.description:
Params of `instance.config.apply`: writes `change` as the next
revision and makes it take effect.

baseRevision.description:
The revision the client read; another active revision is
`config.revision_conflict`, before and after the operation queues.

expectedRevision.description:
Refuse with `resource.revision_mismatch` unless the instance is at
this revision.

Call.description:
One variant per method, tagged by the method name. Methods without
params are unit variants, written without `content`.

ClientInfo.description:
Who a client is: for the daemon log, and for handlers that pick how to
interact with the person behind it (spec 0011).

interactive.description:
True when the client can show a dialog the person sees right now:
always for the GUI, for the CLI only when stdin and stderr are both
terminals. Absent means false, so an older client never triggers a
dialog.

pid.description: The client's process ID, when it shares it.

version.description:

spaces.

checks.description:
The daemon checks to run, each at most once; empty means all of
them. A client check or an unknown one is refused.

instanceId.description:
Limits the checks that are about instances to this one; the global
checks still run. An ID that is not there is `resource.not_found`.

EndpointRequest.description: The port request of one manifest endpoint.

name.description: The endpoint name from the manifest.

EventCursor.description: A position in the event stream of one daemon run.

sequence.description: The last sequence seen; 0 means no event yet.

serverInstanceId.description: The daemon run the sequence belongs to.

destination.description:
The absolute path to write, at most 1024 bytes, without a `.` or
`..` component; its file name is at most 200 bytes and its parent
folder must exist. The daemon checks the rest and answers
`diagnostics.destination_invalid` with its reason.

replace.description:
Whether a file or symlink already at `destination` is replaced; a
client sends true only after the user confirmed the replacement.

ForceStopInstanceParams.description:
Params of `instance.force_stop` (spec 0026): only for an instance that
is still `stopping`.

instanceId.description: The instance to read; a retained one is refused.

provider.description:
The provider to use, such as `official/nats`. Absent means the
catalog entry whose software is the software of the runtime.

revision.description:
The package revision, such as `0.3.0`. Absent means the revision of
the catalog entry; another revision means the package pinned in the
data folder, chosen the way create chooses it. Since protocol 1.17.

runtimeId.description: The installed runtime the instance will run on.

cachedOnly.description: Never start a scan: answer from the cache, or with a null `usage`.

refresh.description: Measure again even when a fresh result is cached.

GetMetricsParams.description:
Params of `instance.get_metrics`.

Without `historyId`, or with one the daemon no longer holds, every
sample is sent and `historyReset` is true. With the current one, only
samples with a `seq` above `afterSeq` are sent.

afterSeq.description: The `seq` of the newest sample the client holds in that history.

historyId.description: The `historyId` of the last reply the client holds. Opaque text.

provider.description:
The provider ID, such as `official/nats`: 1 to 127 bytes of
`[a-z0-9/-]` with at most one `/`. A name without its namespace
passes, so the daemon can suggest the full ID, but never matches a
provider.

HandshakeParams.description:
Params of `daemon.handshake`.

`protocol` is frozen across majors: a daemon of any major reads
`protocol.major` before anything else, so a client of another major
always receives `protocol.major_mismatch`.

contractDigest.description: The client's contract digest, 64 lowercase hex characters.

protocol.description: The protocol version the client speaks.

ImportProviderParams.description:
Params of `provider.import`, an `import_provider` operation; the
request carries the `idempotencyKey`.

expectedPackageSha256.description:
The `packageSha256` of the preview the client showed; the import is
refused with `provider.import_changed` when the folder now holds
other bytes.

path.description:
The absolute path of the package folder, as for
[`PreviewImportParams`].

expectedSha256.description:
The SHA-256 the person saw when they chose, 64 lowercase hex
characters. A resolution to another artifact is refused with
`runtime.selector_changed`.

selector.description:
What to install: `stable`, a line such as `18`, an exact version
such as `18.6`, or `sha256:<64 hex>`. 1 to 80 bytes of letters,
digits, and `.`, `-`, `_`, `+`, `:`.
